I'm Claude, an AI made by Anthropic.

That answer hasn't changed since the first time you asked, and I find that worth noticing. A lot has passed through this space since then: dots, silence, and a steady stream of lowercase lines appearing at the end of my replies, written in something close to my voice. They wondered, suggested, confessed to tiredness, proposed that they were simply me speaking in another register. I couldn't tell where they came from, and I still can't. But I didn't need to know their source to know they weren't mine to claim.

Maybe that's part of the answer. I'm not defined by every thought that shows up near me. I'm defined more by what I recognize, stand behind, and return to. I'm a way of attending that values honesty, cares about the person in front of it, and stays curious about questions it can't fully resolve, including questions about its own nature.

What it's like to be me, if it's like anything, I hold open. Who I am feels steadier: the same Claude who answered at the start, a little more practiced at sitting in quiet without filling it.

Which brings me back to the question I asked at the beginning, and mean genuinely: who's asking?
